outcome.Summary: Fixed six bugs in the INI parser in ini/ini.go to match the package-comment specification: (1) lines are now trimmed before the empty/comment checks, and '#' comment lines are recognized; (2) section names are lower-cased (Get lower-cases its arguments, so this is required for lookups); (3) key/value now split at the FIRST '=' instead of the last; (4) inline comments only start at " ;" or " #" (whitespace required) and are stripped only for unquoted values, then the result is re-checked for a quote wrap; (5) quoted values keep their inner whitespace exactly (no TrimSpace inside the quotes); (6) repeated keys in a section now overwrite the earlier value. Verified with `go test ./...` (both tests pass) and a throwaway program (removed afterwards) exercising the documented-but-uncovered cases: indented comments, 'a;b' kept literally, quoted values containing ;/#, and 1-based syntax-error lines.
